faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.intro: Common questions about funnel analysis with OpenPanel.

items.question: Do I need to set up funnels separately from events?
items.answer: No. You track events once (page views, signups, purchases, etc.). Funnels are just a way to arrange those events into steps. Create or change a funnel anytime without changing your tracking code.

items.question: Can I filter funnels by user property or segment?
items.answer: Yes. Each step can have its own filters (for example only users on a specific plan or from a specific campaign), and you can add a breakdown by any event, profile, group or cohort property to see every segment side by side.

items.question: How is funnel data calculated?
items.answer: We count unique sessions (or unique profiles, if you pick that as the funnel group) that did the steps in order within the funnel window. Other events may happen in between. There is no sampling, every event is included, and results update as new events arrive.

items.question: Do the steps have to happen in order?
items.answer: Yes. A session or profile counts for step C only if A, B and C happened in that sequence inside the funnel window. Other events in between are fine; there is no strict mode that would disqualify them.

items.question: What is the funnel window?
items.answer: The time a journey may take from the first step to the last, in hours. The default is 24 hours. A long onboarding funnel might use 168 (a week); a checkout funnel might use 1.

items.question: Session or profile, which should I use?
items.answer: Session (the default) counts journeys completed inside one visit, which suits checkout and sign-up flows. Profile counts a user who starts today and finishes next week, which suits onboarding and activation. The setting is called "Funnel Group".
